Data:Nxs.n.rising.forget.the.matter.json.desc: Whatever might happen with Connie and her Oracle is beyond the knowledge even of the Librarian of Hush House.

Data:Nxs.n.rose.aladim.ask.al-adim.json.label: Ask al-Adim
Data:Nxs.n.rose.aladim.ask.al-adim.json.preface: Did al-Adim find the piebald garden in the ruins of Miah?
Data:Nxs.n.rose.aladim.ask.al-adim.json.desc: 'I did. And to my great surprise, it is not empty. The Glaeterfleoge-kind have descended from their slumbers, and made their home in the ruins of Miah. My patroness has charged me with a mission concerning them…'

Data:Nxs.n.rose.arun.ask.arun.json.label: Ask Arun
Data:Nxs.n.rose.arun.ask.arun.json.preface: Arun spoke of a coming time 'when flowers find moths, and not the other way round.' Is he ready to make any more sense?
Data:Nxs.n.rose.arun.ask.arun.json.desc: 'You are thinking, Librarian, 'is he ready to make any more sense?' A little unkind of you, but we cannot be held responsible for our thoughts, can we? They flutter here and yon like moths under the sun. Like the Glaeterfleoge-kind, in fact, beneath the desert sun. Yes, they have come to Miah. I think the Vagabond has brought them to her garden. I think she's doing something rather wonderful...'

Data:Nxs.n.rose.conclude.json.label: Conclude
Data:Nxs.n.rose.conclude.json.preface: Dismiss the matter of the Dappled Rose. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.rose.conclude.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.rose.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.label: Ask Dagmar
Data:Nxs.n.rose.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.preface: Dagmar spoke of her inclination to seek the dappled rose in Miah. Did she go?
Data:Nxs.n.rose.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.desc: 'Well paint me pink and paint me puce, Libsy. I did make it out there into the desert and I'm dashed glad I did. Vagabond's garden of piebald roses, and a whole tribe of Carapace Cross tucked up among 'em like field-mice in a corn-field. Lovely sight. The old gel's up to something. I rather think I might lend a hand.'

Data:Nxs.n.rose.olympe.ask.olympe.json.label: Ask Olympe
Data:Nxs.n.rose.olympe.ask.olympe.json.preface: Did Olympe learn anything more of the Vagabond's garden in Miah, where once the Moth came at night?
Data:Nxs.n.rose.olympe.ask.olympe.json.desc: 'I can hardly credit it. The Carapace Cross have come to the ruins of Miah - the Glaeterfleoge-kind, if my friend's descriptions are accurate. They nest in the Vagabond's rose-garden. They can only be there at her invitation. I have an inkling as to why. And I'm worried...'

Data:Nxs.n.rose.revealed.conclude.json.label: Conclude
Data:Nxs.n.rose.revealed.conclude.json.preface: Dismiss the matter of the Dappled Rose. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.rose.revealed.conclude.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.saint.aladim.speak.to.al-adim.label: Speak to al-Adim
Data:Nxs.n.saint.aladim.speak.to.al-adim.preface: What happened with the sandalwood image in Strasbourg, in the end?
Data:Nxs.n.saint.aladim.speak.to.al-adim.desc: 'They burned the statue, as I advised. It helped matters. But it was not enough. Dreams roam the Strasbourg night; dreams of wings. I may need your help again...'

Data:Nxs.n.saint.forget.the.matter.json.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.saint.forget.the.matter.json.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.saint.forget.the.matter.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.saint.fraser.ask.fraser.what..label: Ask Fraser what happened
Data:Nxs.n.saint.fraser.ask.fraser.what..preface: What happened with the sandalwood image in Strasbourg, in the end?
Data:Nxs.n.saint.fraser.ask.fraser.what..desc: 'They drowned it, as I asked them to. It was well done. It has opened the way to dreams of those who came before. I'm very pleased; though I know Stanislav has some concerns...'

Data:Nxs.n.saint.stanislav.ask.stanislav.label: Ask Stanislav what happened
Data:Nxs.n.saint.stanislav.ask.stanislav.preface: What happened with the sandalwood image in Strasbourg, in the end?
Data:Nxs.n.saint.stanislav.ask.stanislav.desc: 'They buried it, as I suggested. I'm not sure if it was the right course. It's opened paths from the Wood for dreamers in Strasbourg - knotty, perilous dreams. If the saint-image was a seed, it may be growing faster than I had expected…'

Data:Nxs.n.skin.aladim.freedom.json.label: Freedom?
Data:Nxs.n.skin.aladim.freedom.json.preface: I could ask the Aleppine what became of Abecassis.

Data:Nxs.n.skin.arthur.imprisonment.json.label: Imprisonment?
Data:Nxs.n.skin.arthur.imprisonment.json.preface: Did Lt Moore deliver Abecassis successfully into the custody of the Labyrinth? I could ask him.
Data:Nxs.n.skin.arthur.imprisonment.json.desc: 'The Labyrinth has him… and Echidna is not pleased with me. She had come to see herself as a mother, or perhaps a lover. I don't know. I don't like it. But now I'm in trouble.'

Data:Nxs.n.skin.azita.death.json.label: Death?
Data:Nxs.n.skin.azita.death.json.preface: I could ask Azita what became of Abecassis.
Data:Nxs.n.skin.azita.death.json.desc: 'He died without honour. That pleased the Colonel, but it didn’t please Echidna, who had appointed herself the patroness of Abecassis. Regrettably, the Colonel is not a power one asks for help. So now Echidna's looking for me. I don't like it, Librarian; I don't like it at all.'

Data:Nxs.n.skin.chaima.death.json.label: Death?
Data:Nxs.n.skin.chaima.death.json.preface: Did Lalla Chaima end Abecassis' suffering? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.skin.chaima.death.json.desc: 'I ended him. It was for the best. But Echidna disagrees. And I fear Echidna. I would be a fool not to.'

Data:Nxs.n.skin.fraser.freedom.json.label: Freedom?
Data:Nxs.n.skin.fraser.freedom.json.preface: I could ask Fraser Strathcoyne what became of Abecassis.

Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.arun.ask.arun.json.label: Ask Arun
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.arun.ask.arun.json.preface: What came of the business at Gladwyn Lake? Arun went to watch.
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.arun.ask.arun.json.desc: 'Ah yes. So now the Haustorium has an emissary to the Bureau. Everyone knows that the emissary is something else on the inside. The Bureau is prepared for that. But I think he might actually be Generous Robigo - Protectress of the Haustorium - Name of the Crowned Growth... perhaps the Bureau has it under control. Connie, however, is concerned. I think she's right to be.'

Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.connie.ask.connie.js.label: Ask Connie
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.connie.ask.connie.js.preface: What has come of the business at Gladwyn Lake? Connie tried to deal with the consequences.
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.connie.ask.connie.js.desc: 'It went off much less messily than I expected… but now the ritual's celebrant is the Haustorium emissary to the Bureau. I'm really worried, Librarian. The Haustorium is too close to the Crowned Growth. And now the Bureau is making arrangements with the Haustorium. We need allies. The world is changing. But this is too much. It could be what happened at Ortucchio, all over again, but worse...'

Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.forget.the.matter.js.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.forget.the.matter.js.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.forget.the.matter.js.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.investigated.forget..label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.investigated.forget..preface: Let Connie make up her own mind. The Librarian probably shouldn't get involved with the inner workings of the Suppression Bureau. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.investigated.forget..desc: Stay or go: it's her decision.

Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.stanislav.ask.stanis.label: Ask Stanislav
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.stanislav.ask.stanis.preface: What has come of the business at Gladwyn Lake? Stanislav looked into it for the Green Sages.
Data:Nxs.n.tapestry.stanislav.ask.stanis.desc: 'The reincorporate - the celebrant who's hosting the spirit… I don't want to say 'Nowhere', but I'm thinking 'Nowhere.' The Green Sages were right to worry. And now the reincorporate is running errands between the Haustorium and the Bureau. The Bureau thinks they have it under control, but that's what someone thought at Ortucchio. I know that CMO Lee - Connie - is worried. I am too.'

Data:Nxs.n.wood.agdistis.speak.to.agdist.label: Speak to Agdistis about the Lyterion
Data:Nxs.n.wood.agdistis.speak.to.agdist.preface: What did he learn about the connection between the Lyterion and honey?
Data:Nxs.n.wood.agdistis.speak.to.agdist.desc: 'I have spoken to Liselotte -the Lyterion director. What she is doing - it is regrettable - well-intended, voluntary, but regrettable. You may know that the Cross is a hybrid thing. She is hybridising their children - the larvae of the Blomberende-kind - with her customers. They have chosen it. But they should not. And the Bureau will ensure they do not.'

Data:Nxs.n.wood.douglas.speak.to.douglas.label: Speak to Douglas about his investigation of the Lyterion
Data:Nxs.n.wood.douglas.speak.to.douglas.preface: 'I was wrong. More going on there than I thought.'
Data:Nxs.n.wood.douglas.speak.to.douglas.desc: 'This woman Liselotte. She's putting bees in people. Not bees exactly, it's the bee-Cross, the fellers that used to be around when things were different. And the people are letting her do it. Seem pretty keen on it. But it's a bloody menace, clearly. We can't allow it.'

Data:Nxs.n.wood.ehsan.speak.to.ehsan.abo.label: Speak to Ehsan about the Lyterion
Data:Nxs.n.wood.ehsan.speak.to.ehsan.abo.preface: What did he learn about the connection between the Lyterion and Thirza Blake?
Data:Nxs.n.wood.ehsan.speak.to.ehsan.abo.desc: 'Thirza had contact with the remnants of the Carapace Cross. 'Trafficked with,' they used to say. Dangerous habit, but she had a lot of dangerous habits. Liselotte - the Lyterion director - she's 'trafficking with' them a lot more enthusiastically. Implanting larval Cross in her patients. Oh, they want her to do it, and both sides benefit... but I'm not sure it's a good idea. And the Bureau's noticed.'

Data:Nxs.n.wood.forget.the.matter.json.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.wood.forget.the.matter.json.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.wood.forget.the.matter.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.wood.stanislav.speak.to.stani.label: Speak to Stanislav about the Lyterion
Data:Nxs.n.wood.stanislav.speak.to.stani.preface: What did he learn about the 'rebirth of something old'?
Data:Nxs.n.wood.stanislav.speak.to.stani.desc: 'The Lyterion director - Liselotte - her process involves the implantation of Blomberende larvae in her patients. Perhaps they are willing. But as you would expect, the Bureau has taken notice…'

Data:Nxs.n.wood.stanislav.speak.to.stani.label: Speak to Stanislav about the Lyterion
Data:Nxs.n.wood.stanislav.speak.to.stani.preface: What did he learn about the 'change in the world's pulse'?
Data:Nxs.n.wood.stanislav.speak.to.stani.desc: 'The Lyterion director - Liselotte - her process involves the implantation of Blomberende larvae in her patients. Perhaps they are willing. But as you would expect, the Bureau has taken notice…'
